verdict.rationale: Radar provides a review queue with approve/decline actions (docs-8, docs-21, docs-24) and allow/block value lists that analysts can edit (docs-10, docs-14), giving a manual mechanism for adjusting future screening. However, there is no documentation stating that individual analyst decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes automatically retrain Stripe's global ML model — the closed-loop 'system learns from every case' claim is unevidenced beyond static rule/list edits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated model retraining from case outcomes, evidence that closing a review as fraud/not-fraud feeds back into Radar's risk scoring model rather than just rules/lists.
